taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-b-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-18 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 15.7 | 1.56 | 1.56
2 | 188.9 | 15.69 | 17.25
3 | 183.8 | 0.79 | 18.04
4 | 106.9 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: T-18
Curve type: KQ-type
Aquifer depth: > 18.04 m
Recommendation: Drill to a target depth of at least 40 to 50 m to sufficiently penetrate the saturated fractured/weathered horizon (Layer 4) starting at 18.04 m. Install casing through the upper 18 m to prevent collapse from the overlying layers.
